text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap shows up at my office one
evening
after skipping training.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I really messed up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I just really,
reeeally couldn't miss it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Not the limited-time only Super
Deluxe★Chop
Suey XXXL!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The Chinese restaurant in the shopping
district
has this famous chop suey, but
it's only available
at certain times...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm really, really sorry... I promise I'll
make up for
it in the next practi—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sigh... If only I had known it also causes super deluxe indigestion...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Since Oguri Cap already seems to be
regretting
her decision, I tell her we may
as well give her
stomach a rest.
